site: Public read-only catalogue. Visitors have no account or login; only administrators authenticate.
gate: Apache redirects anonymous external direct GET/HEAD requests to static minimal HTML before PHP/DB. Three-second manual Continue with signed UA-bound HttpOnly issue and pass cookies; issue TTL 300 seconds, pass TTL 1800 seconds.
page_recovery: Preserves original destination, query, and safe #package-tables fragment. Rejects external redirects, premature or forged passes.
allowed_referers: Known same-site and search engine referrers bypass; unknown/no referer is gated. HTTP Referer can be spoofed by scripted clients, so not complete bot proof.
cookie_ui: Necessary only or Allow site-improvement analytics. Choice can be changed/withdrawn using always-visible Privacy settings control. No public accounts.
analytics_enforcement: The JavaScript event sender, PHP access-event handler and PHP page-view recorder require affirmative analytics choice. Apache access logs and CrowdSec security events are separate necessary security processing.
crowdsec: May share detected attacker IP and security signal metadata with CrowdSec CAPI. Firewall bouncer NOT installed/verified.
cloudflare: DNS remains on HostGator. Cloudflare WAF NOT configured.
gdpr_law_note: Irish DPC says analytics consent is required, strictly necessary cookies exempt. Full privacy compliance needs accurate data retention and site-controller contact details.

windows_apache_redirect_hotfix.root_cause: Windows Apache per-directory mod_rewrite with relative redirect target exposed a filesystem-like C:/Apache24/... redirect URL to public clients.
windows_apache_redirect_hotfix.fix: Absolute URL path /catalog/direct-entry.html in .htaccess rewrite substitution.
windows_apache_redirect_hotfix.verification: Actual Apache local virtual-host fixture with simulated external IP checks HTTP 302 and exact /catalog/direct-entry.html Location, alongside static file, trusted search and spoofed-host tests.
